purpose: Resolve the open hospital and speech Phase 3 source holds using independent public sources without changing the frozen routes.

mapping.mortalityReported: All deduplicated admissions with a valid CNES institution identity.
mapping.mortalityWorse: Admissions whose SIH MORTE field equals 1.
mapping.safetyReported: Admissions with at least one usable diagnosis field.
mapping.safetyWorse: Admissions with any diagnosis in ICD-10 T80-T88, Y40-Y59, or Y60-Y84.

hospital.overlapExclusion: Brazil SIH/SUS institutions and admission records are source-independent from the United States CMS development package.

speech.selectionRule: Sort unique participant identities lexicographically, exclude development participant IDs, then admit the first 120 with usable Cookie Theft transcript, metadata, and all frozen feature inputs; require at least 100 after validation.

frozenFeatureImplementations.conceptualBreadth: fastText cc.en.300.bin global all-pair cosine similarity with the published English stopword and filler exclusions.
frozenFeatureImplementations.contextualBreadth: bert-base-uncased token embedding global all-pair cosine similarity.
frozenFeatureImplementations.visualGrounding: OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14; average sentence-to-Cookie-Theft-image cosine similarity.
frozenFeatureImplementations.syntacticOrganization: spaCy en_core_web_sm averaged sentence-level dependency distance excluding punctuation.
frozenFeatureImplementations.adjustedPredictability: mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1 perplexity, log transformed and residualized within English for BERT type-token ratio.

speech.overlapExclusion: Reject any participant identity matching the 291 PLOS/ADReSS-M development participant identities.
